Hi Abel,

I'm reaching out directly about order Shop····. I ordered a Hammer DC08
(480 MH/s), but I received a Thor P2 instead. Support confirmed it was a
warehouse picking error and said the team would send a prepaid return label
for the Thor P2 and arrange my DC08 starting Monday. I haven't heard
anything since.

The Thor P2 is still in its box with everything it came with and is ready
to go back as soon as I get the label. Could you help get the label sent
and let me know when my DC08 will ship?

Thank you for your help.

*Seth H.*
